header.title: Asian tech/AI boom and energy normalization support Singapore, Malaysia region equities

s01_bottom_line.text: Nomura sees sustained AI demand and gradual energy supply-chain normalization supporting a constructive Asia ex-China outlook, with Malaysia and Singapore outperformers and Singapore core inflation lifted above 2.0% by tech-boom spillovers. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
Nomura draws a constructive regional outlook from AI demand, favoring Malaysia and Singapore while cautious on Indonesia and Thailand.
Tech/AI-driven demand spillovers in ASEAN could benefit regional equities and tech supply chains, but the article does not quantify any listed-company earnings effect.

items.text: Nomura expects Singapore to benefit from tech boom spillovers and strong demand, lifting core inflation above 2.0%. ⟨cited figures: forecast⟩
Nomura expects Japan's economy to stay on a recovery path driven by capital spending on software, digitalization and automation to address labor shortages.
Sustained AI demand and gradual normalization of energy supply chains support a constructive outlook across Asia ex-China.
